messages:
marta: Quick design question — updated the variant snapshot announce in the timeline. screenshot: https://redwood.internal/img/snap-ann-1.png Can we tighten the SR announce and surface an explicit 'Undo snapshot' CTA in the diff drawer? Thoughts? sam: +1 on surface area. We should be explicit about undo vs rollback (undo = local snapshot revert; rollback = deploy-level). Microcopy proposal: 'Snapshot saved — undo' or 'Undo snapshot'. Short is better. kevin: implementation notes: adding an Undo CTA in the drawer is straightforward but we need to ensure focus management + a short-lived confirmation token to avoid replay by back button. Will add telemetry for undo clicks. aria: Accessibility nits: if we announce both "Snapshot saved" and then immediately open the drawer with another live region, SRs will hear duplicate info. Prefer a single aria-live update that says "Snapshot saved. Drawer opened. Press undo to revert." Also move keyboard focus into the drawer when opened. marta: Good point. Also thinking about motion — should the drawer slide in or appear instantly for screen readers? kevin: Slide-in is ok if we set focus at the end of the animation. Example small snippet we can use: ```html
Snapshot saved. Undo snapshot for service X
``` Make sure the link text includes service/version for context. aria: Prefer role="status" over aria-live="polite" in some browsers; role="status" implies polite. Also ensure the 'Undo' link has full descriptive text for screen readers: 'Undo snapshot for checkout-service, v2'. Avoid ambiguous "Undo" alone. sam: Copy tweak: what about "Snapshot saved — undo" vs "Snapshot saved. Undo"? I prefer the dash variant because it reads better in a single SR announcement. marta: I'll iterate on copy and attach updated comps (desktop + 320px). Also want a small discoverability hint under the timeline: 'Most recent snapshot • 5m ago' so people notice they can rewind. kevin: small layout note: the timestamp + badge combo can clip at narrow widths if we use non-wrapping. I'll make the badge wrap and reduce left padding. deploy-bot: Draft rollback policy doc updated by @sam — https://redwood.internal/docs/deploys#undo (edited) aria: After the first prototype is up please do a quick VoiceOver (mac) + NVDA (win) test. I can pair with QA to validate focus flow and announcement phrasing. marta: Plan: I'll upload 3 comp variants by end of day: - A: drawer slides + long SR text - B: instant drawer + concise SR text - C: compact timeline label + inline undo CTA Next steps: kevin will prototype on staging, aria + QA test SR, sam will final copy sign-off. sam: Ack and thanks everyone :thumbsup:
